_comment: PLUGIN DEFAULT CONFIG: committed, read-only at runtime. Per-PC values (the PainterlyNPR folder when it is not where library.rootCandidates look, a chosen python.exe, the picture toggle, the last tab) live in 91__UserConfig__LocalOnly/. The library, its numbering and its rules belong to PainterlyNPR (12__Data__AssetLibrary and its register): nothing here decides a number.

library._comment: rootCandidates are tried in order: the Na__PainterlyNPR repo folder on each studio PC (forward slashes). Settings > Choose Folder overrides them on one PC. Every other path is relative to that folder, exactly as PainterlyNPR's build utility and app read them. pathLimit is the longest absolute path SketchUp's Ruby can open (259 even with Windows long paths on).

python._comment: PainterlyNPR's build utility gives every Id and every verdict (next, validate, index). executable: a full path to python.exe to use instead of the search (Settings can set one per PC). The search takes the newest Python 3 found at searchPatterns (%NAME% is an environment variable), then python.exe on PATH, never the Windows Store stub (it runs, prints nothing and exits 0). preferWindowless runs pythonw.exe beside it, so no console window flashes; its output still reaches the run log. timeoutSeconds stops a run that hangs.

proxy._comment: How a MOD (the factory's GLB proxy) becomes a SketchUp component when an asset has no SKP yet, and what that component then saves as its SKP. Materials are named materialPrefix + the PainterlyNPR material class (NPR__Timber), so a client model's own Timber is never taken over, and carry the class in an attribute. Coplanar triangles merge into faces; an edge between faces closer than the soften angle (degrees between their normals) is softened and smoothed: organic assets (a Kind in their recipe: trees, shrubs, grasses) read as masses, objects keep their arrises. weldDecimalsInch rounds positions before shared corners are matched (3 = a thousandth of an inch, SketchUp's own merge distance).

materials._comment: The Materials tab: one swatch per PainterlyNPR material class. The swatches (names, colours, classes) are the materials SSOT's series, dataLibFile relative to the Plugins folder; the pictures and groups are the PainterlyNPR library's register (relative to the repo folder), swatchSlot RND (pen and wash) or PXY (proxy). glassPattern and glassBelowAlpha copy PainterlyNPR's own Glass rule (Na__GlbScenes__Config.json Recognition.Glass): a face whose material matches, or is less opaque, keeps it when a swatch paints a whole group or component.

nprViewport._comment: The NPR Viewport and NPR Parameters windows: PainterlyNPR's own app page, from its GitHub repo, cached on this PC (93__RemoteCache__CoreEngine) and served by the plugin's local server; the model's GLBs cached per project (92__UserProjects__ProjectCache), only what changed re-exported. Nothing of the engine is in this plugin (Adam, 01-Nov-2026).

remoteEngine._comment: Where PainterlyNPR comes from. git downloads it with this PC's own GitHub credentials (Git Credential Manager), a shallow, sparse clone of the branch's latest commit: only the files the engine reads when it runs (ValeVision AURA's pin selection: the modules, the asset library's and material recipes' .json and .webp, the stylesheets) plus the app page and its icons. It downloads when the cache is missing and on Reload Remote Plugin Files. git: a full path to git.exe when it is not on PATH. timeoutSeconds stops a download that hangs.

server._comment: The plugin's web server on 127.0.0.1 (Python, threaded): the engine, the windows' host scripts and the GLB caches. port is the usual one (the windows' browser storage is per port); when it is taken the system chooses another for that session.

live._comment: Live NPR updates (on when the NPR Viewport opens: the viewport's user config, live.onWhenOpened). idleSeconds: how long the model must be still after a change before its stale GLBs are exported (the export runs on SketchUp's own thread). cameraSeconds: the most often SketchUp's camera is sent while it moves.

projectCache._comment: One folder a project in 92__UserProjects__ProjectCache: <model title, folderNameChars>__<8 hex of its path>, short so every GLB path stays under SketchUp's 260 characters. keepProjects: the most recently opened projects kept (the oldest deleted, never the one open). keepExportLogs: the GLB builder's logs kept per project. materialMode: whitecard (every material Default, MAT000E__ exempt ones kept with their colour: the engine reads the <tag>::<material> node names), or auto (Cloud Sync's rule: a __MaxModel project keeps its SSOT MAT###__ materials).

assets._comment: includeProxies: the PainterlyNPR library assets placed in the model (this plugin's proxies) are drawn as the engine draws them (its generators, from the asset's record in the cached library), at SketchUp's position, turn and scale.

sceneImport._comment: How the cached GLBs become the engine's objects: ValeVision AURA's import rules (its AppConfig AuraConfig__SceneImport__Rules, scene API 1.2.0, Adam to set), by file name, the first rule whose every condition the file meets (Match: in its Id; Kind: Mesh or Linework; Group; VariantStarts; VariantContains), plus rows for the GLB builder's storey files (<prefix>__Storey__<Floor>__<Element>) and the landscape file under its older name. A component node's type word can override (componentRules). skipNodes: TrueVision's drawing notes. recentreM: how far the focal building may move from the engine's origin before the placement is set again. PROVISIONAL, as AURA's are.

nprExport._comment: NPR Export (v0.3.0): pictures of the NPR Viewport's drawing, drawn by the engine's own still export (PNG with its print size, a true-size PDF; JPEG made from its PNG) at a print resolution on the engine's sheet, for the current SketchUp view or ticked scenes. Each model keeps its own export settings (its NPR settings record); defaults are what a model starts with and what Reset Export Settings puts back. dpiPresets: the resolution buttons (127 is the engine's screen sheet). dpiLimits: the lowest and highest a custom resolution may be. readySeconds: how long an export waits for the NPR Viewport to have the model. itemTimeoutSeconds: how long one picture may take before the export stops (600 dpi on a small graphics card is slow).

defaults._comment: views: current (the SketchUp view) or scenes. format: png, jpeg or pdf. folderMode: besideModel (the subfolder beside the .skp; empty: its own folder) or chosen. fileName tokens: {model} {view} {dpi} {date} {time} {seed}. ifExists: number (add __02 ...) or replace.

author._comment: A selected component made into a new library asset. author goes into the DAT's Meta. originToleranceMm: how far the component's origin may sit from the centre of its base before the form offers to move it there (the library's Origin is BaseCentre). defaults: what a new asset of a collection, or of a collection and type ('07/Trees'), starts with; '*' is the fallback. The 07, 10 and 25 rows are the seeded assets' own recipes (v0.6.0); the other collections hold no asset yet, so their rows are PROVISIONAL guesses (the nearest stand-in generator, an existing material class and role) for Adam to correct. The form fills them in when the collection or type changes and every field stays editable.
